title: Saleslify
summary: Flutter front end for Saleslify, an inventory management platform — designer wireframes turned into responsive, interactive components.

caseStudy.overview: Saleslify is an inventory management platform with a Flutter front end.
contribution: Turned designers' wireframes and mockups into interactive UI components.
Applied responsive design so it works across device sizes.
Implemented state management for data handling and UI updates.
Added custom widgets, animations and gestures.
caseStudy.team: Worked closely with the project's designers.
caseStudy.approach: Designer wireframes and mockups were translated into interactive Flutter components, with responsive layouts so the screens work across device sizes.
